mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *,(@rank :=@rank + 1) AS rank FROM (SELECT f.user_id , u.nick_name AS nickName, u.small_icon AS smallIcon, f.win AS win, f.lose AS lose, f.draw AS draw, u.point As total FROM t_free_game_total f JOIN t_user u ON f.user_id = u.userid GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY point DESC ) u, (SELECT @rank := 0) AS it ) t WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT * FROM (SELECT *,(@rank :=@rank ) AS rank FROM (SELECT f.user_id , u.nick_name AS nickName, u.small_icon AS smallIcon, f.win AS win, f.lose AS lose, f.draw AS draw, u.point As total FROM t_free_game_total f JOIN t_user u ON f.user_id = u.userid GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY point DESC ) u, (SELECT @rank := 0) AS it ) t WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT f.total FROM t_free_game_total f JOIN t_user u ON f.user_id = u.userid WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT *, (@rank :=@rank + 1) AS rank FROM ( SELECT f.user_id, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.small_icon AS smallIcon, f.win AS win, f.lose AS lose, f.draw AS draw, u.point AS total FROM t_free_game_total f JOIN t_user u ON f.user_id = u.userid GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY point DESC ) u, (SELECT @rank := 0) AS it LIMIT 0, 10
mapper.update: UPDATE t_free_game_total t SET t.win = t.win + #{win}, t.draw = t.draw + #{draw}, t.lose = t.lose +#{lose}, t.total = t.total + #{total} WHERE t.user_id = #{user_id}
